import pickle,numpy as np

 t=np.where(good & ~np.isin(np.arange(len(X)),v))[0]; e=np.column_stack([A(X[v],k)@np.linalg.lstsq(A(X[t],k),Y[t,k],rcond=None)[0] for k in j])-Y[v]; print(len(v),np.max(abs(e)),np.sqrt(np.mean(e**2)))
